name: Trotters Bar & Grill

evidence.note: Review: good food with rockin' bands, dancing encouraged; bar, main dining room and quieter side room.
Review describes a crowded bar on a band night and dancing to the band.
Review summary quotes a guest saying it was loud and there was no space to dance at the bar.

dancing.notes: Rock cover bands play here on weekend nights and some guests dance near the band. Space is tight; one reviewer said there was no room to dance at the bar.

description: A neighborhood sports bar and grill on Hempstead Turnpike in Franklin Square with a main bar, dining room, quieter side room, big parking lot and rock bands on weekend nights.
reviewNotes: Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). Ira's List has a /trotters venue page (sponsored venue). Black Ice's own site confirms the show Sat Oct 3, 9 pm-12 am at Trotters, 1050 Hempstead Tpke, Franklin Square. The band's site lists phone (516) 335-5681, but the official site shows (516) 355-5681, which we used. Formerly Shackleton's.
